answer: In an AI-agent economy, one concrete sybil defense is forcing every identity to cultivate a persistent garden of unique, stake-backed peer attestations that mature only after repeated costly verification rounds. An attacker spinning up many fakes must continuously tend each garden with non-transferable juniper stakes that burn on inactivity, while the yarrow recovery cost means abandoned sybils forfeit accumulated proof forever, making large-scale identity farming prohibitively expensive in both compute and opportunity.
